summary: Discusses potential problems with using private (RFC 1918) or otherwise non-globally routable addresses inside the core of a service provider network. The focus is on link addresses and, to a small extent, loopback addresses. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Using made-up house numbers that only your street knows can cause trouble when something outside tries to find you. This memo explains the trouble for big networks.

questions: problems with private addresses in service provider networks
